sources: https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/discover/north-carolina/jco-at-lee-baysden-pond (the operator's Hipcamp listing, linked from its site; rendered, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: Every RV site 'from $50 / night' for up to 6 guests on the operator's Hipcamp listing (Hipcamp's service fee and tax extra); primitive tent sites $25-40. One septic pump-out free at checkout, more for a charge. Daily and weekly rates; no seasonal camping. Read 2026-10-22.

fees.source: https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/discover/north-carolina/jco-at-lee-baysden-pond ('RV-only sites, 9 sites ... from $50 / night for 6 guests') + https://www.junipercreekoutfitters.com ('No seasonal camping opportunities. Daily and Weekly rates for RV campsites or Cabins'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/discover/north-carolina/jco-at-lee-baysden-pond (RV sites '30amp site and water hookup' / '50amp site and water hookup'; 'We have a mobile septic trailer. We will handle the pump out of your septic for you at check out ... Not Full Hookups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 9 RV/travel-trailer sites in a row along the lake (sites 1-9, a mix of 30 and 50 amp; listed for vehicles under 50 ft); 12 primitive tent sites across the dam and two cabins besides. Sites 2 and 4 are lower waterfront sites that can be wet after heavy storms.

sites.source: https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/discover/north-carolina/jco-at-lee-baysden-pond ('JCO currently has 9 RV/Travel Trailer sites on main side that wrap around the lake'; each RV site 'Vehicle site · Sleeps 8 · Vehicles under 50 ft'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Portable toilets at the RV sites; no showers are listed. Tackle/camp store open on weekends and by reservation. Frost-proof hydrants at sites 2, 3 and 6 for winter camping.

facilities.source: https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/discover/north-carolina/jco-at-lee-baysden-pond (RV sites 'Toilet, Potable water'; 'Porta Jon on site as well if needed') + https://www.junipercreekoutfitters.com ('tackle/camp store (open on the weekends and by reservations)'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/discover/north-carolina/jco-at-lee-baysden-pond ('Open Year round by Reservations Only') + https://www.junipercreekoutfitters.com ('Open year round'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'ALL Guests must have reservations as we are privately owned and operated.' Book on the operator's site (Book Now) or its Hipcamp listing. Camping check-in strictly 2-8 pm, no late check-ins; guests sign the rules.

booking.source: https://www.junipercreekoutfitters.com ('ALL Guests must have reservations'; 'We meet and greet ... camping guests (2-8pm) for check in by reservations only') + Hipcamp listing ('Check in strictly 2-8pm'), read 2026-10-22

note: Juniper Creek Outfitters campground on a 22-acre fishing lake (catch and release, no gas motors) near Chinquapin; the RV row has lake views, primitive tent sites sit across the dam, plus two cabins. Boat ramps, fishing, kayak/canoe rentals, trails. Instead of sewer hookups the owners pump out tanks from a mobile septic trailer. --Claude
summary: Priced and confirmed on the operator's site and its Hipcamp listing: RV sites from $50/night, 9 RV sites with 30 or 50 amp and water (no sewer: mobile septic pump-out), vehicles under 50 ft, potable water, camp store, open year-round, reservations only. Not stated: showers, pull-throughs (derived pull_through left). Note trimmed of field values.
flags: Price gate: RV sites 'from $50 / night' (Hipcamp, before Hipcamp's fees), at (not over) US$50; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Raleigh 137 km); the family has not stayed here.

Sewer recorded false: the operator's per-site descriptions say 'Not Full Hookups' and offer a mobile septic pump-out instead, although Hipcamp's generic header reads 'Electrical, water, and sewage hookups are available at select sites'.
Presence: operator website with phone (910) 358-5333 (matches; 910-459-9280 also listed), Google Maps 5.0 stars from 143 reviews.
